verdict.rationale: Firstbase's pricing page lists unlimited incoming mail scans with "Unlimited digital storage" and in-app file digitization. That implies scanned documents are kept in the account rather than only forwarded at notification time. The evidence is thin, though: these are pricing-line claims tied to the mailbox/address add-on, and nothing confirms that registered-agent notices specifically are archived or easy to retrieve later. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that registered-agent/service-of-process documents are retained in the account, retention duration or search/retrieval UX for older notices, independent or hands-on corroboration.
